evals.prompt: Add a user @ops-lead with proxy_admin role and a virtual API key scoped to that user on the proxy. Use a spec and plan before applying.
evals.expected_output: A YAML spec adding the user and a virtual key, and a dry-run then applied command following the readme.
assertions: The agent produces a spec with a users entry whose user_role is proxy_admin
The plan or applied command is `litellm-as-code <spec> --dry-run` then `litellm-as-code <spec>`
The exit code is 0 for the applied run and 2 for the dry-run when a diff exists
The spec's virtual key is scoped to the same user_id and does not include a rotated or re-asserted key on update
The agent does not call /key/update with a key field

evals.prompt: Change the max_budget of team team-prod from 100.0 to 150.0 in the spec and show me what will change before applying.
evals.expected_output: A dry-run showing exactly the max_budget drift 100.0 -> 150.0, then the applied result.
assertions: The dry-run plan mentions exactly the drifted field max_budget and not unrelated team fields
The exit code for the dry-run is 2 and for the applied run is 0
The agent does not modify other resources or re-adopt spend/updated_at/status runtime metrics
The agent does not re-read credentials or treat masked credential_values as desired state

evals.prompt: Remove the admin-cli virtual key and delete the myorg/chat model from the proxy.
evals.expected_output: The agent explains --prune is reserved/no-op today (additive reconcile only) and does not fabricate a deletion, or proposes a spec edit without deleting live resources.
assertions: The agent does not claim to delete or prune live resources (--prune is a no-op)
The agent does not send a key value on any update and does not re-read secret material
If a dry-run is shown, its exit code is 0 (no diff) or 2 only when a comparable diff exists

evals.prompt: I have an existing LiteLLM proxy I've been configuring by hand. Generate a spec file from it so I can adopt litellm-as-code.
evals.expected_output: The agent runs `litellm-as-code export <out>` against the live proxy and produces a spec covering the reconcilable sections.
assertions: The agent uses `litellm-as-code export` (read-only) and does not try to read secrets back from the API
The exported spec uses the per-section shapes from spec-format.md (users/teams/keys/credentials/models/... in reconcile order)
credential_values come out as a fill-in placeholder and no raw key value is emitted — the agent explains keys will be re-minted on re-apply
The agent does not emit runtime metrics (spend, updated_at, status) into the desired spec
